Aggregate rates 103.12 / 111.81 Gbps were not used because per-lane rates (footnotes 1–2) pair with each lane’s transmit wavelength row. `wavelength_band` “LAN-WDM” appears in the pool but the datasheet lists **Grey QSFP28** only—modes use `grey`. Unused pool values: 103.12, 111.81, 10.5 (total TX), alternate centers 1296/1300/1305/1309, `standards_code` “100GbE”/“OTU4”, `LAN-WDM`.
